allow: PowerShell($ports = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5000,5001,5005,7000,7001,7005,8080,4200 } | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess -Unique; if \($ports\) { $ports | ForEach-Object { $proc = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "$\($_.LocalPort\) -> PID $\($_.OwningProcess\) \($\($proc.ProcessName\)\)" } } else { 'no listeners on common dev ports' })
